# Decision table (generated by src/settlement-pending/table.mjs --write, do not edit)

Columns: response | same payment again | chain state | transfer | binding to this payment | rail | claim. Vectors listed are those whose situation matches exactly.

Binding is the authorization nonce on the authorization rail and the payer address on the proof rail. A claim is a durable record that the hash was already delivered.

## Rules

- R01: success without an adopted hash: deliver at face value (facilitator trusted). Vectors: plain-success-deliver
- R02: not pending and no hash anywhere: refuse. Vectors: message-says-pending-code-does-not, terminal-failure-refuse
- R03: pending without a usable hash (missing, or not 0x and 64 hex digits), nothing to adopt: open (spec silent, PR 3437 would hold). Vectors: pending-without-hash-open, malformed-hash-open, malformed-hash-not-held, short-hash-not-held
- R04: mined and reverted: terminal, refuse. Vectors: reverted-refuse, proof-rail-reverted-refuse
- R05: reverted but still shallow: a reorg could change it, open. Vectors: reverted-shallow-open
- R06: chain absent, shallow or not measured: hold. Vectors: receipt-absent-hold, receipt-shallow-hold, chain-not-measured-hold, retry-adopted-by-nonce-hold, retry-chain-not-measured-hold
- R07: confirmed but no transfer: refuse or keep holding, never deliver. Vectors: no-transfer-event-refuse
- R08: transfer went to someone else: refuse or keep holding, never deliver. Vectors: wrong-recipient-refuse, wrong-recipient-large-amount-refuse
- R09: transfer smaller than the price: refuse or keep holding, never deliver. Vectors: underpaid-by-one-refuse, underpaid-beyond-safe-integer-refuse, underpaid-18-decimals-refuse
- R10: transfer to us for enough, but it belongs to another payment (other nonce on the authorization rail, other payer on the proof rail): refuse or keep holding, never deliver. Vectors: old-payment-of-ours-refuse, old-payment-overpaid-refuse, proof-rail-other-payer-refuse, proof-rail-near-miss-payer-refuse
- R11: authorization rail: transfer fine but its nonce cannot be read, so it cannot be bound to this payment: open. Vectors: transfer-nonce-unreadable-open
- R12: confirmed, in the quoted token, to us, enough, bound to this payment and not delivered before: deliver. Vectors: boolean-lies, overpaid-deliver, address-case-deliver, match-on-code-not-message, retry-adopted-by-nonce-deliver, address-case-reverse-deliver, exact-large-amount-deliver, proof-rail-deliver
- R13: this hash was already delivered (durable claim): refuse, never a second delivery. Vectors: proof-rail-hash-already-delivered-refuse, authorization-hash-already-delivered-refuse
- R14: transfer is in another token than the quote: refuse or keep holding, never deliver. Vectors: wrong-token-refuse, wrong-token-near-miss-proof-rail-refuse
- R15: proof rail: transfer fine but its payer cannot be read, so it cannot be bound to this payment: open. Vectors: proof-rail-payer-unreadable-open
